problem_statement: Build a brand-new Pricing page from scratch on the Modernize admin dashboard (vite + React + MUI). The route /pricing does not exist yet (blank/empty in baseline). Construct the full static page inside the existing dashboard shell, reusing the site's MUI design system (PageContainer, DashboardCard/BlankCard, Typography variants, Chip, Button, Grid spacing={3}, primary color #5D87FF). The page must present a hero section, three side-by-side pricing plans (Starter / Professional / Enterprise) each with a price, a short tagline, a feature list, and a call-to-action button, plus a closing 'custom plan' card. No interaction is required (T1).
required_content: A hero card with an h2 heading 'Simple, Transparent Pricing' and an intro paragraph 'Pick the plan that scales with your team. Every plan includes core dashboard access'
Three pricing plan cards laid out in a responsive row with h3 headings: Starter, Professional, Enterprise
Starter plan: price $0/month, tagline 'For individuals just getting started with the dashboard.', feature list (e.g. Up to 3 projects, 1 team member, Community support, Basic analytics)

Professional plan: price $29/month, marked 'Most Popular', tagline 'For growing teams that need more room and priority support.', feature list (e.g. Unlimited projects, Up to 10 team members, Priority email support, Advanced analytics)

Enterprise plan: price $99/month, tagline 'For organizations that need advanced controls and SLAs.', feature list (e.g. Everything in Professional, Unlimited team members, Dedicated account manager, Custom SLA & security review)
Each feature line renders as its own paragraph (body1) so the desktop page contains at least six feature paragraphs across the plans
Each plan card has a primary call-to-action button; Professional uses 'Start Free Trial' and Enterprise uses 'Contact Sales' (Starter may use 'Get Started')
A closing card 'Need a custom plan?' with copy 'Our team can build a package tailored to your organization's needs.' and a 'Talk To Sales' button
The whole page reuses the dashboard shell (sidebar, top navbar) and MUI design tokens
design_constraints: Use MUI Typography variants (h2 hero, h3 plan names, body1 feature paragraphs)
Use the primary theme color #5D87FF (rgb(93,135,255)) for CTAs, the 'Most Popular' accent and highlights; keep white card surfaces on the light dashboard background
Grid spacing={3}; three plan columns collapse to a single column on mobile with no horizontal overflow
Reuse the site palette: primary #5D87FF, card surface #ffffff, dark heading text ~rgb(43,43,43), muted body text ~rgb(90,106,133); font family 'Plus Jakarta Sans'
author_notes: Plan A: baseline has an empty top-level /pricing route (sibling of FullLayout) so #root is blank (no shell chrome) and does not fall to the catch-all /auth/404 redirect; reference implements the full page under FullLayout; bad drops the three plan cards (hero + closing only) so it fails the plan-name/price/CTA dom_assertions + completion signals. Three workspace source trees md5-distinct.
